text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel to run in such a famous
race?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Running with that great group of
talented
athletes was such a blast!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
choice_data_list: You looked like you were having more fun than ever before.
You looked like you were having more fun than ever before, huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! It's partly because I ran with so
many
great racers...
choice_data_list: You looked like you were having more fun than ever before.
You looked like you were having more fun than ever before, huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But mostly, I felt like I really succeeded
at making
everyone want to go after
me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I do believe I'm going to enjoy running
next
year—or rather, next year and all
the years after!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now that this year's final race is over, it's time for the final drive!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's hit the road and finish the year off
right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen comes to a close for
Maruzensky
after a very satisfying race.
